verdict.rationale: Built-in virtualization is a fair question for an operating system, but the evidence pack never documents a macOS capability for quickly creating and running virtual machines without manual configuration. The only nearby item is a support-guide heading, "Run Windows on your Mac" (macos-docs-18). It does not say this uses VMs, nor that macOS creates or runs them with zero setup. It is adjacent at best and earns no credit.
